group.description.wz.group: HmWz - All commands related to WZ registration
command.description.wz.registration.regi: Sign up for a WZ event
command.description.wz.registration.rese: Remove non-permanent registrations and purge the registration and configured channels by default.
command.description.wz.registration.purg: Confirm channels before deleting up to 500 messages in each.
command.description.wz.setup.configure: Configure the WZ registration for this server
parameter.description.wz.setup.configure: Optional registration role (default: none; only available if a role is already configured)
parameter.description.wz.setup.roles.add: Whether the role is permanent (optional, default: false)
command.description.wz.setup.purge_chann: Add multiple channels to the registration reset purge list (maximum 25 channels)
Remove multiple channels from the registration reset purge list
command.description.wz.setup.message: Set the message for the WZ registration.
parameter.description.wz.setup.message.t: Title for the message (max. 256 characters; default: not set)
parameter.description.wz.setup.message.m: Text for the message (max. 4096 characters; default: not set)
UTF-8 encoded TXT file containing the message (max. 4096 characters; default: not set)
parameter.description.wz.registration.re: Whether the response should be private (default: false)
Whether configured channels are purged during reset (default: false)
